register: Informal tu throughout (545 strings with tu/tuo/puoi/hai, no Lei forms found), which is the standard for Italian consumer apps; buttons and menu items use the imperative 2nd person singular (Salva, Aggiungi sito, Segna come letto) or a noun phrase, confirmation titles use the infinitive question (Eliminare la cartella?), and any Lei form (Inserisca, Selezioni, La preghiamo, Suo/Sua addressed to the reader) is flagged as register.

terms.use: articolo (l'articolo, gli articoli; masculine agreement: letto, salvato, condiviso, nascosto, i più recenti / i più vecchi, lo/li, un)
terms.note: The catalog mixes articolo (~426 strings), notizia (~375) and storia (~321), often on the same screen. Articolo is the term Italian RSS readers use and fits blog posts, podcasts and videos; notizia is newspaper-specific and storia is a calque of 'story'. Normalizing the story term is low severity (terminology) unless the wording misleads. Keep notizie where the English says 'news' (lettore di notizie, Flusso di notizie, 'Leggere le notizie è più bello con gli amici'). When switching to articolo, fix every adjective, participle, article and pronoun in the string (la storia letta → l'articolo letto, salvate → salvati, le più recenti → i più recenti, una → un, la/le → lo/li).
Sito web is fine in prose.

terms.use: feed (il feed, i feed; invariable plural)
terms.note: Compounds: feed RSS, feed web, elenco dei feed, icona del feed. Also avoid where it means this concept: feeds.
Parent folder → cartella superiore or cartella principale (do not churn).

terms.use: non letto / non letti (masculine, agreeing with articolo)
avoid: non letta / non lette (feminine, from notizia/storia)
terms.note: Slider and filter labels: Tutti / Non letti / In evidenza. Unread only → Solo non letti. Next unread story → Articolo non letto successivo (or Prossimo articolo non letto). Mark as unread → Segna come non letto. 'Leave unread' keeps stories unread → Lascia non letto / Lascia come non letti. 'Da leggere' reads as a to-read list; flag it as low terminology on labels, fine only in running prose such as 'nessun articolo da leggere'.

terms.use: Segna come letto / Segna tutto come letto / Articoli letti
avoid: Leggi articoli / Leggi le notizie (for the Read Stories folder)
Contrassegna (do not churn, but prefer Segna)
terms.note: 'Read Stories' is the folder of stories already read: Articoli letti, never the imperative (high when imperative). Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed to read it: Leggi %@ (high if it says mark as read). Mark newer/older as read → Segna come letti i più recenti / i più vecchi.
Unsave → Rimuovi dai salvati; Unsaved → Rimosso dai salvati. Also avoid where it means this concept: memorizza.
A share as a noun: condivisione (%d condivisioni).
Product name, never translated; follow the English capitalization. 'Profile & Blurblog' → Profilo e Blurblog (keep the & token when the English has it: Profilo & Blurblog).

The catalog uses Addestramento dell'intelligenza for both the Trainer dialog and Training; keep it. Train → Addestra; Train this story → Addestra questo articolo; story trainer → addestramento dell'articolo; site trainer → addestramento del sito. 'Addestramento intelligente' (smart training) is a slightly different phrase but tolerated in marketing prose; do not churn it.

terms.use: In evidenza (as the name of the level: articoli in evidenza, Non letti + In evidenza, Solo in evidenza)
avoid: a fuoco / mettere a fuoco (photographic focus)
terms.note: Catalog plurality (in evidenza 14, focus 9, plus five other words). Slider: Tutti / Non letti / In evidenza. Focus stories → articoli in evidenza; 'Focus view/mode' → vista In evidenza (or rephrase: tra gli articoli in evidenza); verb 'focus or hide' → mettere in evidenza o nascondere. NewsBlur's English itself says 'highlight stories' for focus. The text highlighter is evidenziare/evidenziazione (Evidenzia, Rimuovi evidenziazione); that is a different, verb-based term and does not clash. In prose 'focus on what matters' may stay concentrarsi su. Also avoid where it means this concept: Obiettivo.

terms.use: Mi piace / Non mi piace / Non mi piace per niente
terms.note: Super dislike → Non mi piace per niente (already the Android wording; it always hides). The trainer's 'beats' means Like outranks Dislike: batte / prevale su (never ritmi). '(like wins)' → (prevale Mi piace). Words inserted into 'What do you %(like)s and %(dislike)s about this…' must read correctly inside the template (check reader_classifier.js and TrainerView.swift).
Hidden stories → articoli nascosti.
Prompt classifier → classificatore con prompt (not 'dei prompt'); Regex classifiers → classificatori regex.

terms.use: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
avoid: Archivio Premium / archivio Premium / l'Archivio Premium (for the plan)
premium lowercase as the plan name
terms.note: Plan names stay in English as product names, matching the App Store and Play Store products and the German, Spanish, French and Portuguese decisions (catalog split 31 Archivio Premium vs 31 Premium Archive). 'Archivio Premium' reads as a premium story archive. Use them without an article (Passa a Premium Archive) or with piano/abbonamento (il piano Archive, un abbonamento Premium Archive). Archivio stays for the story archive itself (archivio degli articoli, il tuo archivio). Flag Archivio Premium as medium terminology. Generic lowercase 'premium feature/account' → funzionalità Premium / account Premium.
Catalog-consistent. 'Upgrade from X' (Android/iOS pricing) means upgrading away from the current plan to a higher one; check it does not read as a downgrade.

terms.use: Preferenze (NewsBlur's Preferences) / Impostazioni (settings in general and the iOS/Android system Settings)
terms.note: Do not churn between them when the English says Settings.

terms.use: feeds, sites, newsletters: iscriversi / iscrizione / iscritti; paid plan: abbonarsi / abbonamento / abbonati
avoid: Abbonati as a feed Subscribe button (also reads as the noun 'subscribers' and suggests paying)
abbonamenti for the list of followed feeds
terms.note: Italian uses iscriviti for free content (YouTube, newsletters, podcasts) and abbonamento for paid plans; the catalog mixes abbona 135 / iscri 82 with no split. Flag feed-context abbonarsi/abbonamenti as low terminology (medium when it misleads, e.g. 'Hai molti abbonamenti!' in the OPML export, or an 'Abbonati' button). A feed's subscriber count → %s iscritti. Unsubscribe from a feed → Annulla l'iscrizione. Keep abbonamento/abbonati for Premium, renewals, billing and 'premium subscribers'.
Sentence case. 'your river' in prose → il tuo flusso.

avoid: Tutte le storie del sito / Tutte le notizie del sito / Tutti gli articoli del sito (= all stories of one site)
terms.note: It means stories from all sites (high when it says one site).

avoid: Articoli poco frequenti / Notizie poco frequenti
Articoli occasionali del sito / meno frequenti del sito (one site)
terms.note: Stories from sites that publish rarely (below a stories-per-month threshold); the stories are not infrequent, it is not one site, and it is not about how often the reader visits. 'siti aggiornati di rado' is a correct prose paraphrase (From infrequent sites → Dai siti aggiornati di rado is fine). 'Infrequent stories per month' (the threshold setting) → Soglia dei siti poco attivi (articoli al mese).

terms.concept: Widely Read / Long Reads / Good Reads / Global Shared
terms.use: Articoli più letti / Letture lunghe / Letture consigliate / Articoli condivisi globalmente
avoid: Buone letture (reads as the wish 'happy reading')
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books.
Catalog-consistent.

avoid: Riepilogo quotidiano / Riepilogo giornaliero (for the feature)
terms.note: Catalog plurality (briefing 44 vs riepilogo quotidiano 27 + riepilogo giornaliero 15), matching the French decision. Riepilogo is reserved for summaries (Ask AI summaries, story summaries, the briefing's summary style), which the catalog already translates as riepilogo in ~30 strings, so naming the briefing 'riepilogo' collides ('Briefing quotidiano con riepiloghi degli articoli'). Morning/Afternoon/Evening Briefing → Briefing del mattino / del pomeriggio / della sera; Weekly → Briefing settimanale; Twice-daily → Briefing due volte al giorno. 'Brief' (a summary length next to Medium/Detailed) → Breve; 'Editorial' (narrative style) → Editoriale (fine).

Catalog-consistent. The Ask AI input placeholder 'Follow up…' may stay Domanda successiva… (Android) or Approfondisci… (iOS); flag 'Da seguire...' (web), which means 'to be followed'. The Daily Briefing section 'Follow-ups' (new posts from feeds you recently read) → Sviluppi, never Risposte.
Catalog majority.

terms.use: Segui (button) / Follower (followers) / Seguiti (the people I follow) / Persone che seguo / Mi seguono
terms.note: 'I'm Following' and 'Following Me' tabs must be distinguishable: Persone che seguo / Mi seguono (or Seguiti / Follower).

avoid: Disattiva (for mute, collides with disable notifications)
terms.note: Mute site → Silenzia sito; Unmute → Riattiva; Muted → Silenziato.

terms.use: vista (Vista feed, Vista testo, Vista articolo, Vista originale)
terms.note: Visualizzazione is tolerated; do not churn unless two labels of the same switcher disagree.

terms.use: notifiche / newsletter (invariable) / Scopri (iOS, Android, verbs) and Esplora (web tab, tolerated)
terms.note: Do not churn Scopri/Esplora.

terms.use: Sentence case for labels and titles; month and weekday names lowercase; typographic quotes “…” (or « ») when a translation adds quotes; keep the English ellipsis style (… or ...); apostrophes ' or ’ both tolerated (do not churn)
avoid: English Title Case copied into Italian (Riepilogo Giornaliero, Articoli Salvati)
ASCII double quotes the English does not have
terms.note: Prices are written 36 $/anno in the catalog; fine.

terms.use: Positive? → Sei sicuro?; Stale → Inattivo / Inattivo da %s; beats → batte (BEATS → BATTE); (like wins) → (prevale Mi piace); Upgrade from Premium/Archive → Passa a questo piano da Premium/Archive; pattern → pattern (or schema), never modello (collides with the AI Modello); Unsaved (HUD) → Rimosso dai salvati; Replied (HUD) → Risposta inviata; Cancel unfollow → Continua a seguire; Mute None → Riattiva tutto
avoid: Passa da Premium (reads as leaving the plan)
terms.note: Decisions made while auditing chunks 1-11.

terms.use: web '%(time)s fa', iOS '%@ fa', Android '%1$s fa' wrap the server's bare units ('%(number)d giorni'); Italian 'N giorni fa' needs no case change, so the wrappers are fine. Compact forms: %dg fa, %dh fa, %d min fa, %d sett. fa, %d mese fa / %d mesi fa
avoid: plural nouns in a one form or a non-plural compact string (1 giorni fa, 1 mesi fa)
terms.note: iOS compact '%ldd ago'/'%ldh ago' are non-plural keys, so they use the abbreviations g/h.
